title: Sheriff of Cumulopolis demo
author: Den_er_da_hvid
selftext:
This is a playable demo of my idea. Taking inspiration from the boardgame Sheriff of Nottingham and Papers Please.   
I would like general feedback on how to make it fun (I am not satisfied with day1. But I think it gets better) and feedback on ui elements.   
What works what dos not.   
\*site note, I like the leasure mode best. Should I drop the timed mode entirely?   
[Link to Itch](https://den-er-da-hvid.itch.io/sheriff-of-cumulopolis)   
  
The final game is played over 4 weeks, in 4 different areas of the city, with 30+ goods, more intriguate puzzles and better graphics.

Workflow: the demo is made with claude in html. The actual game is made in Löve2d and graphics is made with inkscape.
